title: OOS Atlas Edit
author: 0xldr
summary: On behalf of @atlas-axis , we are submitting the Out Of Schedule Atlas Edit proposal below. This proposal includes the following edits: Authorize Genesis Capital Transfer To Launch Agent 4 - Authorizes a transfer of 21,000,000 USDS to Launch Agent 4 for its Genesis Capital. Add Documentation For Rate Limits On Base - Adds rate limits on Base for Grove. Authorize Genesis Capital Transfer To Launch Agent 4 Add new subdocuments of A.2.9.2 - Active Ecosystem Accords (Portal) / A.2.10 - A2 - Ecosystem Accords - Active Ecosystem Accords (GitHub) . These documents should be located directly after A.2.9.2.3 - Ecosystem Accord 3: Sky and Keel (Portal) / A.2.10 - Ecosystem Accord 3: Sky and Keel (GitHub) and its subdocuments to read as follows: A.2.10 - Ecosystem Accord 4: Sky And Launch Agent 4 (Core) - The subdocuments herein record the terms of agreement between Sky and Launch Agent 4 as agreed in Ecosystem Accord 4. A.2.10 - Accord Key Details (Core) - The subdocuments herein set out the key details of Ecosystem Accord 4, such as parties to the agreement and the duration of the Accord. A.2.10 - Parties To The Accord (Core) - The parties to Ecosystem Accord 4 are Sky and Launch Agent 4, as defined in the subdocuments herein. A.2.10 - Sky Details (Core) - The party ‘Sky’ comprises Sky Core. A.2.10 - Launch Agent 4 Details (Core) - The party ‘Launch Agent 4’ comprises the Launch Agent 4 Prime Agent, Launch Agent 4 Foundation, and Rubicon. A.2.10 - Duration Of The Accord (Core) - The duration of Ecosystem Accord 4 is indefinite, commencing from November 13, 2025. A.2.10 - Accord Substantive Terms (Core) - The subdocuments herein set out the substantive terms of Ecosystem Accord 4. Additional detail regarding the substantive terms of Ecosystem Accord 4 will be specified in a future iteration of the Atlas, as agreed by the Parties to the Accord. A.2.10 - Genesis Capital Allocation (Core) - The subdocuments herein set out agreed terms with respect to Genesis Capital Allocation. A.2.10 - Launch Agent 4 Initial Allocation (Core) - The Initial Allocation for Launch Agent 4 is 21,000,000 USDS. A.2.10 - Initial Allocation Distribution (Core) - The Initial Allocation is distributed in USDS to the Launch Agent 4 SubProxy. A.2.10 - Transfer Of Genesis Capital Allocation To Launch Agent 4 SubProxy (Core) - The transfer of 21,000,000 USDS from the Surplus Buffer to the Launch Agent 4 SubProxy for the Genesis Capital Allocation must be included in the November 13, 2025 Executive Vote. This action is authorized to proceed directly to an Executive Vote without a prior Governance Poll. Replace A.3.7.1.5.5 - Genesis Agents (Portal) / A.3.9 - Genesis Capital Backstop - Genesis Agents (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.9 - Genesis Agents (Core) - Genesis Agents are Agents that receive capital contributions from Sky, including, without limitation: Spark Grove Keel Launch Agent 3 Launch Agent 4 Replace A.3.7.1.5.6.1 - Amount Of Capital Contributed By Sky To Agents (Portal) / A.3.9 - Genesis Capital Backstop - Genesis Capital - Amount Of Capital Contributed By Sky To Agents (GitHub) to read as follows: A.3.9 - Amount Of Capital Contributed By Sky To Agents (Core) - The amount of capital contributed by Sky to Agents is: Spark - 25,000,000 USDS Launch Agent 4 - 21,000,000 USDS Add new subdocuments of A.AG5.3 - Omni Documents (Portal) / Launch Agent 4 - Omni Documents (GitHub) . These documents should be located directly after A.AG5.3.2 - Strategic Intent And Operating Model (Portal) / Launch Agent 4 - Strategic Intent And Operating Model (GitHub) and its subdocuments to read as follows: Ecosystem Accords (Core) - Launch Agent 4 has formally agreed to the Ecosystem Accords herein. Ecosystem Accord 4 (Core) - Launch Agent 4 engaged in terms of agreement with Sky in Ecosystem Accord 4, located in A.2.10 - Ecosystem Accord 4: Sky And Launch Agent 4. Add Documentation For Rate Limits On Base Add new subdocuments of A.AG2.2.6.P15.2.1.1.3 - RateLimits (Portal) / Grove - RateLimits (GitHub) . These documents should be located directly after A.AG2.2.6.P15.2.1.1.3.2 - Avalanche (Portal) / Grove - Avalanche (GitHub) and its subdocuments to read as follows: Base (Core) - The documents herein list the current RateLimits for the Grove Liquidity Layer on Base. USDC Base ALM Proxy Maximum (Core) - The maximum amount of USDC that can be sent to the Base ALM Proxy ( LIMIT_USDC_TO_DOMAIN , hashed with Base domain) is specified in the document herein. • maxAmount : This parameter will be specified in a future iteration of the Grove Artifact. • slope : This parameter will be specified in a future iteration of the Grove Artifact. USDC Base ALM Proxy Circle Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol Maximum (Core) - The maximum amount of USDC that can be bridged to Base ALM Proxy using the Circle Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol ( LIMIT_USDC_TO_CCTP_Base ) is specified in the document herein. • maxAmount : 50,000,000 USDC • slope : 50,000,000 USDC per day USDC Base ALM Proxy Circle Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol Maximum (Core) - The maximum amount of USDC that can be bridged to Ethereum Mainnet from the Base ALM Proxy using the Circle Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol ( LIMIT_USDC_TO_CCTP_Ethereum ) is specified in the document herein. • maxAmount : 50,000,000 USDC • slope : 50,000,000 USDC per day
